description: Calculate a person's birthday angel number from their birth date, exactly as Anahana's free Angel Numbers Calculator does: every digit of the date summed and reduced to one digit, times 111 (so the answer is 111, 222 ... 999). Returns the number, the method, its meaning and article url when Anahana publishes one in that language, and the calculator page. Read-only; the birth date is used for this answer only and is not stored.

birth_date.description: The birth date as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "1990-07-04".

language.description: Language for the linked pages, e.g. "de". One code; defaults to "en".

name: calculate_angel_number
title: Calculate a birthday angel number
